competition.intro: Prize money comes from results: wins, top-10 finishes and other cuts, each paid at the tour's average prize, plus prize money earned outside the main circuit. Each event costs its entry fee, travel and caddie fee; the coach is paid a fixed fee for the year. Caddie and coach also take a share of winnings.

tip.circuit: Choosing a tour fills in its average prizes for that year: Alps, Challenge and DP World Tour in Europe; PGA Tour Americas, Korn Ferry and PGA Tour in the United States, converted from dollars. Choose Custom values to keep your own.
tip.events: Tournaments entered during the year. Per-event costs are multiplied by this number.
tip.cuts: Tournaments where the cut was made, including wins and top-10 finishes. Cannot exceed events played.
tip.top10s: Top-10 finishes that were not wins. Wins plus top 10s cannot exceed cuts made.
tip.wins: Tournaments won. Also used for the bonus per win of sponsorship contracts.
tip.prizePerWin: Average winner's cheque on this tour.
tip.prizePerTop10: Average cheque for a top-10 finish that is not a win.
tip.prizePerCut: Average cheque for a cut made outside the top 10.
tip.otherPrizeMoney: Prize money from events outside the main tour: national championship, invitations.
tip.entryFeePerEvent: Entry fee paid for each tournament.
tip.travelPerEvent: Transport, hotel and meals per tournament.
tip.caddieShare: Share of winnings paid to the caddie. 0.08 = 8 % of prize money.
tip.coachAnnualFee: Fixed fee paid to the coach for the year, whatever the number of events.
tip.coachShare: Share of winnings paid to the coach. 0.05 = 5 % of prize money.

issue.winsAboveCuts: wins plus top-10 finishes ({count}) exceed cuts made ({cuts})
issue.sharesAboveOne: caddie and coach shares together exceed 100 % of winnings

contract.intro: One line per contract with its value for each year; leave a year at 0 when the contract is not active. The bonus per win is paid on the wins entered on this scenario's Competition products, for contracts active that year.

tooltip.requirements: Total financing needs for the year: capex, WCR increase, dividends, loan repayments, and operating shortfalls.
tooltip.capex: Total capital expenditure for the year, pulled automatically from the Capex module. Represents cash needed to purchase or build fixed assets.
tooltip.wcrIncrease: Increase in Working Capital Requirement — additional cash tied up as receivables and inventory grow faster than payables. A positive value means more cash is needed.
tooltip.dividends: Cash dividends paid out to shareholders. Enter your planned distribution for each year. Leave at zero if no distribution is planned.
tooltip.loanRepayments: Principal repayments on outstanding loans, computed from the debt repayment schedule configured in Settings.
tooltip.grantRepayments: Repayment of repayable grants (avances remboursables). Enter the scheduled repayment amount per year.
tooltip.negativeOperatingFlow: Cash shortfall when operating activities consume more cash than they generate. This gap must be covered by financing resources.
tooltip.totalRequirements: Sum of all financing requirements: capex, WCR increase, dividends, loan repayments, grant repayments, and negative operating flows.
tooltip.resources: Total financing resources available for the year.
tooltip.operatingCashFlow: Self-financing capacity when operating activities are cash-positive: net profit + depreciation. Automatically sourced from the P&L.
tooltip.capitalIncrease: Cash raised from new equity issuances. Enter planned fundraising amounts per year. Use the "Structure raise" button to link an amount to a Cap Table round.
tooltip.currentAccountContrib: Shareholder current account contributions — short-term cash injections by shareholders, typically interest-free and repayable on demand.
tooltip.longTermLoans: Principal received from new long-term bank loans or bonds. Enter the drawdown amount per year. Repayments are recorded under Requirements.
tooltip.subsidies: Non-repayable grants and subsidies received (e.g. BPI innovation grants, public aid). These do not need to be repaid.
tooltip.otherGrants: Other non-repayable grants or contributions not classified elsewhere (e.g. EU programmes, regional subsidies).
tooltip.repayableGrants: Soft loans or repayable innovation grants received (avances remboursables). Enter amounts received per year; schedule repayments under Grant Repayments.
tooltip.assetSales: Cash proceeds from the disposal of fixed assets. Enter the expected sale price per year.
tooltip.totalResources: Sum of all financing resources: operating cash flow, equity raises, loans, subsidies, grants, and asset sale proceeds.
tooltip.annualBalance: Annual surplus or deficit: total resources minus total requirements. Green = fully funded; red = funding gap that still needs to be covered.
tooltip.cumulativeCash: Cumulative cash position at year-end, starting from the opening balance. Persistent negative values indicate structural under-financing.
tooltip.netProfit: Net profit for the year as reported in the P&L statement. Starting point for the indirect cash flow method.
tooltip.depreciation: Add-back of non-cash depreciation and amortisation charges. Depreciation reduces profit but does not consume cash.
tooltip.disposalGainLoss: Gain or loss on asset disposals recognised in the P&L. Added back here to avoid double-counting — cash proceeds appear in Investing Activities.
tooltip.changeInWCR: Change in Working Capital Requirement: an increase ties up cash (negative); a decrease releases cash (positive). Computed from receivables, inventory, and payables movements.
tooltip.totalOperating: Net cash generated or consumed by operating activities: net profit + depreciation ± WCR change. The core measure of cash-generation ability.
tooltip.cfCapex: Cash paid for capital expenditures (fixed asset purchases), drawn from the Capex module. Shown as a negative outflow.
tooltip.assetDisposals: Cash received from the sale of fixed assets, sourced from the Asset Sales entry in the Financing Plan.
tooltip.disposalGainsLosses: Net P&L gain or loss on asset disposals (book value minus sale price). Enter as positive for a gain, negative for a loss.
tooltip.totalInvesting: Net cash used in investing activities: capex outflows minus asset disposal proceeds.
tooltip.capitalIncreaseFlow: Cash received from new equity issuances. Sourced from the Capital Increase entry in the Financing Plan.
tooltip.currentAccountFlow: Cash received from shareholder current account contributions. Sourced from the Financing Plan.
tooltip.newLoansAndGrants: Total cash inflows from new long-term loans, subsidies, repayable and non-repayable grants combined.
tooltip.dividendsFlow: Cash paid out to shareholders as dividends. Sourced from the Dividends entry in the Financing Plan.
tooltip.loanGrantRepayments: Cash paid for loan principal repayments and repayable grant repayments combined.
tooltip.totalFinancing: Net cash from financing activities: inflows from equity, debt, and grants minus outflows for dividends and repayments.
tooltip.netChangeInCash: Total net cash movement for the year: operating + investing + financing flows combined. Positive = cash accumulated; negative = cash consumed.
tooltip.openingCash: Cash balance at the start of the year (closing balance of the prior year). Year 1 opening cash is set in Settings → Opening Balance.
tooltip.closingCash: Cash balance at year-end: opening cash + net change in cash. This is the actual bank balance and matches the Balance Sheet cash line.

tooltip.netCashFlow: Total cash inflows minus outflows for the month (Revenue + Financing − Operating − Capex). Positive = net cash generated; negative = net cash consumed.
tooltip.openingBalance: Cash balance at the start of the month. Equals the closing balance of the previous month. For Month 1 of Year 1, this is the initial cash balance set in Settings.
tooltip.closingBalance: Cash balance at month-end = Opening Balance + Net Cash Flow. Negative values (highlighted in red) indicate a liquidity shortfall — additional financing must be arranged to cover this gap.
